question_text: Find the number of ways in which 4 letters can be put in 4 addressed envelopes so that no letter goes into the envelope meant for it.

recall_prompt: Say how you would count the ways of putting four letters in the wrong envelopes — the derangement formula, and the number.
insider_note: The signs in the derangement bracket alternate: 4!(1/2! − 1/3! + 1/4!) = 12 − 4 + 1 = 9. Keeping all three terms positive, or stopping before the 1/4! term, are the two standard ways to miss it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Derangement formula
steps.margin_note: First mark. "No letter in its own envelope" is a derangement. Dₙ = n!(1 − 1/1! + 1/2! − 1/3! + … + (−1)ⁿ/n!); the first two terms cancel.
steps.memory_tip: 'No letter in its own envelope' is a derangement. The first two terms of the series cancel.
lines: No letter in its own envelope: a derangement.

recall.must_convey: That the count is the derangement number, n factorial times the alternating series 1 minus 1 over 1 factorial plus 1 over 2 factorial and so on, with n = 4.
accept: it is a derangement, n factorial times one minus one by one factorial plus one by two factorial minus one by three factorial plus one by four factorial
use the derangement formula with n four
four factorial into half minus one sixth plus one twenty fourth
derangement formula, four factorial into the alternating series
no letter in the right envelope means derangements

steps.why: The formula comes from inclusion–exclusion: start with all 4! arrangements, remove those fixing at least one letter, add back those fixing two, and so on. Knowing it is inclusion–exclusion explains the alternating signs.
common_mistakes: Answering 4! − 4 = 20, as if only the "all correct" cases were removed.
Stopping the series at 1/3! and forgetting the 1/4! term.

steps.label: Evaluate D₄
steps.memory_tip: 24(1/2 − 1/6 + 1/24) = 12 − 4 + 1 = 9. The signs alternate — do not add all three.

recall.must_convey: That 24 times the bracket gives 12 minus 4 plus 1 = 9.
accept: twenty four times half minus one sixth plus one twenty fourth is twelve minus four plus one which is nine
twelve minus four plus one is nine
twenty four into bracket cheste twelve minus four plus one, nine

steps.why: Multiplying 24 into each fraction gives whole numbers 12, 4 and 1; the alternating sum is 9. A direct listing of the 9 derangements of four letters confirms it.
